source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top Assassination parses
summary: Mutilate builds 2 combo points per cast (requires daggers, must be behind target). Keep Slice and Dice up, maintain Rupture, Envenom as the finisher when Deadly Poison stacks are available. Cold Blood guarantees a crit.

Sinister Strike.note: Combat ability - wrong spec for a Mutilate rogue; use Mutilate to build combo points

Hemorrhage.note: Subtlety ability - wrong spec for a Mutilate rogue

breakpoint.note: Mutilate generates 2 combo points per cast, making it a faster combo builder than Sinister Strike when positioned behind the target. Deadly Poison must be applied to both weapons for Envenom to be effective. A parse with no Envenom casts may indicate wrong weapon enchants.

advisory: Mutilate requires being behind the target - positioning on bosses is critical. Deadly Poison stacks fuel Envenom (the Assassination finisher). Cold Blood (guarantees a critical strike on a 3-minute cooldown) should be paired with Envenom for maximum burst. Unlike Combat, Assassination performs poorly when you cannot maintain behind positioning - flag this as a potential log note. Fight notes: behind-positioning fights punish Mutilate uptime - on movement-heavy or frontal-cleave bosses (Hydross transitions, Leotheras, Kael phase swaps) expect dips, and on Vashj/Kael where uptime is king Mutilate's combo-point density shines. Assassination is pure single-target; on add waves (Karathress adds, Council) you offer no real cleave, so tunnel the priority target rather than swapping.
